name: NSW regional student concession (TCEC)
summary: Outside the Opal network, full-time students need a Transport Concession Entitlement Card to get concession fares.
key: Free to get and free to renew each year.
who: Australian citizens or permanent residents who live in NSW.
Enrolled full-time, on campus, in an accredited higher education or VET course.
how: Apply on the Transport for NSW tertiary students page. Your uni doesn't issue the card.
Show the card when you buy a concession ticket from a regional bus, train or coach operator.
catches: In regional NSW, your uni student ID is not accepted as proof. Only the TCEC is.
Where you live is judged by where you sleep on class days.
We haven't confirmed how big the discount is, so no figure is shown.
A replacement card may cost a fee.

source.label: Transport for NSW: guidelines for tertiary student concessions (May 2026)
